boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Rhode Island School of Design
boards.description: Ten food-focused Providence destinations with currently published late hours; confirm service before heading out.

cards.title: Chinatown on Thayer
cards.subtitle: 277 Thayer Street, Providence
cards.notes: Check the day before leaving: the restaurant publishes midnight closings Monday–Wednesday and 2am closings Thursday–Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A Thayer Street Chinese restaurant with late posted closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Chinatown on Thayer lists hours until 12am Monday–Wednesday and until 2am Thursday–Sunday at 277 Thayer Street.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: 11am–12am Monday–Wednesday; 11am–2am Thursday–Sunday. Recheck for holiday changes.

cards.title: Caliente Mexican Grill
cards.subtitle: 267 Thayer Street, Providence
cards.notes: Use the published daily 1am closing time as a planning window, then confirm availability directly with the Thayer Street location.
cards.short_summary: A College Hill Mexican grill that posts a 1am close every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Caliente Mexican Grill lists its Thayer Street location at 267 Thayer Street as open 10am–1am seven days a week.
cards.source_title: Caliente Mexican Grill — Thayer St. Providence
cards.access_notes: Published hours: 10am–1am, seven days a week. Confirm hours before travel.

cards.title: Fellini Pizzeria
cards.subtitle: 166 Wickenden Street, Providence
cards.notes: For a later Wickenden stop, aim for Thursday through Saturday, when the shop posts 2am closing times.
cards.short_summary: A Wickenden Street pizzeria with midnight-to-2am published hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Fellini Pizzeria at 166 Wickenden Street lists hours until midnight Monday–Wednesday and Sunday, and until 2am Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published closing: midnight Monday–Wednesday and Sunday; 2am Thursday–Saturday. Verify before going.

cards.title: Antonio's Pizza by the Slice
cards.subtitle: 256 Thayer Street, Providence
cards.notes: Choose Friday or Saturday for the latest listed window, and check the location page again before making the walk.
cards.short_summary: A Thayer Street pizza shop posting 2am Friday and Saturday closes.
cards.evidence_claim: Antonio's Pizza at 256 Thayer Street lists hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and until 2am Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published closing: midnight Sunday–Thursday; 2am Friday–Saturday. The page states slices and whole pies are available.

cards.title: East Side Pockets
cards.subtitle: 278 Thayer Street, Providence
cards.notes: Build a late stop around Thursday through Saturday, when the official hours page lists a 2am close.
cards.short_summary: A Mediterranean food destination on Thayer Street with 2am late-week hours.
cards.evidence_claim: East Side Pockets at 278 Thayer Street lists hours until midnight Monday–Wednesday and until 2am Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published closing: midnight Monday–Wednesday, 2am Thursday–Saturday, and 10pm Sunday. Recheck before departure.

cards.title: Baja's Tex Mex Grill
cards.subtitle: 273 Thayer Street, Providence
cards.notes: The location page lists the same 2am closing time every day; use it as a late-food option after confirming current service.
cards.short_summary: A Thayer Street Tex-Mex grill whose official listing posts daily 2am hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Baja's Tex Mex Grill at 273 Thayer Street lists hours of 10am–2am Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours for the 273 Thayer Street location: 10am–2am daily. Confirm service before visiting.

cards.title: Haven Brothers Diner
cards.subtitle: 12 Dorrance Street, Providence
cards.notes: Plan for downtown evening service: the diner publishes 2:30am closes Sunday–Thursday and 3:30am Friday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A downtown diner trailer with the latest published closing times in this set.
cards.evidence_claim: Haven Brothers Diner lists its Providence location at 12 Dorrance Street as open 5pm–2:30am Sunday–Thursday and 5pm–3:30am Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Haven Brothers Diner — Full Late Night and Dinner Menu
cards.access_notes: Published hours: 5pm–2:30am Sunday–Thursday and 5pm–3:30am Friday–Saturday. Verify changes directly.

cards.title: Yumi Bar
cards.subtitle: 75 Fountain Street, Providence
cards.notes: Use Thursday through Saturday for the 2am listing; the official page also identifies the Fountain Street address.
cards.short_summary: A downtown food and beverage spot with 2am Thursday–Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Yumi Bar lists its Providence location at 75 Fountain Street as open until 2am Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: until 11pm Monday–Wednesday, until 2am Thursday–Saturday, and until 11pm Sunday. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: Sicilia's Pizza
cards.subtitle: 181 Atwells Avenue, Providence
cards.notes: Check the takeout schedule first: it lists 2am closings Monday–Thursday and 3am Friday, with split Sunday hours.
cards.short_summary: An Atwells Avenue pizza restaurant publishing late takeout hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Sicilia's Pizza at 181 Atwells Avenue lists takeout hours until 2am Monday–Thursday and until 3am on Friday.
cards.access_notes: Published takeout hours include 10am–2am Monday–Thursday and 10am–3am Friday; review the page for weekend split hours.

cards.title: Pizza Queen Weybosset
cards.subtitle: 215 Weybosset Street, Providence
cards.notes: For the longest published window, plan Friday or Saturday, then verify that late carryout service remains available before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A Weybosset Street restaurant listing carryout until 3:30am on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Queen Weybosset lists carryout hours until 1:30am Sunday–Thursday and until 3:30am Friday and Saturday at 215 Weybosset Street.
cards.access_notes: Published carryout hours: 10am–1:30am Sunday–Thursday; 10am–3:30am Friday–Saturday. Confirm before travel.
